Tests for relative pkg path queries.

-- flags --
-ignore_extra_diags

-- go.mod --
module mod.test/resolvetarget

go 1.25

-- f/a/a.go --
package a

var XYZ = "a" //@target(f_a_XYZ, "mod.test/resolvetarget/f/a", "XYZ", "XYZ")
var ABC = "a" //@target(f_a_ABC, "mod.test/resolvetarget/f/a", "ABC", "ABC")

//@resolvetarget("XYZ", "", f_a_XYZ)

// can't access things in test package.
//@resolvetarget("XYZ_TEST", "", err="target XYZ_TEST not found in mod.test/resolvetarget/f/a")

-- f/a/a_test.go --
package a_test

var XYZ = "a_test" //@target(f_a_test_XYZ, "mod.test/resolvetarget/f/a_test", "XYZ", "XYZ")

var XYZ_TEST = "a_test" //@target(f_a_test_XYZ_TEST, "mod.test/resolvetarget/f/a_test", "XYZ_TEST", "XYZ_TEST")

// prefers the XYZ in the current package (a_test)
//@resolvetarget("XYZ", "", f_a_test_XYZ)

// can't access anything in non-test package.
// TODO: maybe change this to be resolved correctly
//@resolvetarget("ABC", "", err="target ABC not found in mod.test/resolvetarget/f/a_test")

-- f/a/ --

// users need to be able to specify a pkg in the directory they are currently in.
//@resolvetarget("a.XYZ", "", f_a_XYZ)
//@resolvetarget("a_test.XYZ", "", f_a_test_XYZ)

// If calling with a pkg directory, only the non-test is found.
//@resolvetarget("f/a.XYZ", "", f_a_XYZ)

// Can't even query for unique test package targets using a pkg path.
// This can only be done using local directory resolution (as in relying on the current directory).
//@resolvetarget("f/a.XYZ_TEST", "", err="target XYZ_TEST not found in mod.test/resolvetarget/f/a")

// Returns both matching targets in this directory
//@resolvetarget("XYZ", "", f_a_XYZ, f_a_test_XYZ)

//@resolvetarget("XYZ_TEST", "", f_a_test_XYZ_TEST)
